articles.summary: Today, Horizon Quantum announced that it expects to locate its second quantum computer—an IonQ 256-qubit system—in Dublin, Ireland. By locating this frontier system at its European headquarters, the company aims to benefit from Ireland’s growing quantum ecosystem, strong university network, and robust talent pool for deep-tech development.
articles.title: Horizon Quantum announces Dublin as its second quantum computer testbed location, bringing a frontier quantum system to Ireland
